svg.aria-label: Fig. 5 Retire, two queues and the in-flight window
svg.text: Fig. 5 Retire, two queues and the in-flight window
Uops retire in program order as coalesced groups. A second queue limits uops that change the register map.
... 330 groups, retired up to 8 groups per cycle
a memory op starts a group, a branch ends one, at most 4 issuing uops per group
(Handley reads the same data as one failable slot per row; the rule is inferred)
slots 5 to 7 only take non-issuing uops (NOP, B, eliminated moves)
uop that writes a register: old physical reg, new physical reg
on a mispredict the map is walked back from the tail
the old physical register is freed when the entry retires
confirmed by 8 claims; the mechanism reading is inferred
how many instructions can sit past a long-latency load
coalesced queue: 330 x 4 issuing uops per group (approx.)
